// why: `tsc` with no `-p`. The configuration is then chosen by a search for `tsconfig.json` upwards from `cwd`, that is from a value set elsewhere in `project.json` — the target's reach stops being visible at the point of the call. The same check rejects `tsc --build`, which `--listFilesOnly` cannot describe, so the gate would have nothing to measure point 4 with.
